gaps.explanation: 'Applause' is the noun; 'applaud' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: The company needs to ___ (MODERN) its factories.
He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (SHORT) of funds forced him to abandon the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Shortage of funds' — the noun for an insufficient amount.

gaps.sentence: He's a regular ___ (CONTRIBUTE) to the magazine.
The project's ___ (FAIL) was due to poor planning.
The economy shows signs of ___ (RECOVER) after the recession.
The journal gave full ___ (COVER) to the election.
gaps.explanation: 'Media coverage' — the noun for how much something is reported.
